finding: [Observed] Before this slice the proposal section's --proposed left border did not render on the reading layout: polaris.ts's later '.claim-section { border: 0 }' (same specificity) overrode '.proposal { border-left: ... }'. The browser sweep of the live slice-5 capture computes the section's border-left-color as rgb(223, 233, 231) (--ink, the currentColor of a zero-width border) and finds no label symbol. The generated rule now selects '.claim-section.proposal'; the colour token is unchanged, so this restores the declared treatment rather than recolouring it.
